title: Fact
description: One checkable statement about the match. Lines of the poem cite facts by id.

id.description: f1, f2 and so on, unique within the fact sheet.

text.description: One plain sentence, such as: 70': Alexander Isak scored. Brentford 1, Liverpool 2.

source_ref.description: The event's source_ref from get_match_events, or the URL of a search result.

speaker.description: Quotes only: who said it, as the source attributes it; null otherwise.
